title: Garden of Ten Thousand Venoms
text:
Yun opened the battle.

**TRANSCENDED ART — Ten Thousand Venoms Become One.**

Her toxin families stopped behaving separately and began shifting according to Huo's resistance.

If he isolated one route, another venom became dominant. If he purged through sweat, another entered through damaged skin. If circulation slowed, the lungs became the target.

For twenty-one seconds, Huo stopped advancing.

Then Wheel Three isolated the adaptive venom. Wheel Four altered the purge rhythm. Wheel Six burned through accumulated toxin debt.

Huo stepped forward.

Yun retreated.

[[speaker:huo]]“Good.”

[[speaker:yun]]“I preferred rude.”

Sera watched every Wheel response.

Yun had not failed.

She had forced information out of a man who had once terrified Dukes.

title: Eighty-One Silent Nails
text:
Luo Wen attacked second.

World Rank #9. Physician. Acupoint executioner.

He entered beneath a Heaven-Burial swing and struck nine points before Huo's elbow completed.

Then nine more.

**TRANSCENDED ART — Funeral Meridian: Eighty-One Silent Nails.**

Eighty-one progressive acupoint disruptions designed to shut down circulation in overlapping sequences.

Wheel Two slowed.

Wheel Five lost output.

Wheel Seven stuttered.

Huo's left side went numb.

Then Wheel Four rebuilt the severed links through alternate routes.

[[speaker:luo]]“Very annoying.”

He completed sixty-three points before Huo caught his wrist.

Sera's wire snapped around Luo's waist and pulled him clear.

Huo looked toward her.

[[speaker:huo]]“Six.”

[[speaker:sera]]“Later.”

title: One Sword, No Second Line
text:
Arin Vale entered third.

World Rank #8. Silver Sword Saint.

**TRANSCENDED ART — One Sword, No Second Line.**

Each cut existed only to find the single structural seam connecting two active Wheels at that exact instant.

Arin found it.

One silver line crossed Huo's chest.

For three seconds, Nine Heavens Beneath the Empty Throne disconnected.

All Wheels went silent.

Sera's eyes widened.

Then Wheel Nine erased the forced pattern.

Wheel Four rebuilt the links.

Everything restarted.

Arin smiled.

[[speaker:arin]]“Three seconds.”

Three seconds against this Huo was enough to change the plan.

title: Ten Thousand Pages Bury the Sky
text:
Mo had prepared since dawn.

Every page carried a different qi instruction.

Turn. Fold. Delay. Shield. Cut. Reflect. Break.

**TRANSCENDED ART — Ten Thousand Pages Bury the Sky.**

The battlefield became a moving scripture.

Huo could not simply memorize it because Mo continuously rewrote the instructions through Inkless Thread.

Pages closed.

Opened.

Changed.

Finally Huo stopped trying to read them.

Heaven-Burial Hand struck the ground.

Wheel Eight multiplied the contact through buried paper anchors.

Half the formation tore itself apart.

Mo's face changed.

[[speaker:mo]]“That was expensive.”

Huo walked through falling pages.

Mo withdrew.

Still smiling faintly.

[[speaker:mo]]“Worth it.”

Sera had seen Wheel Eight clearly.

title: Pale Orchid Beneath a Moonless Heaven
text:
Sera entered last.

World Rank #6.

Huo looked at her.

[[speaker:huo]]“Why last?”

[[speaker:sera]]“Because I was watching.”

Wire vanished into the grass.

Her movement softened.

**TRANSCENDED ART — Pale Orchid Beneath a Moonless Heaven.**

False positions, wire tension, footwork, qi suppression and killing geometry collapsed into one shifting state.

Every place Huo expected her to be became slightly wrong.

For several exchanges, the Empty Throne could not identify the real Sera.

She reached Arin's cut line.

Needle entered.

Huo bled.

[[speaker:sera]]“Found you.”

Then three Wheels synchronized.

Pressure.

Adaptation.

Stored force.

The battlefield detonated.

Sera crossed both arms and flew thirty metres.

Rhen moved half a step from the ridge.

Stopped.

Sera stood.

Blood at her mouth.

Still fighting.

title: All Five Marquises
text:
The Marquises attacked together.

Yun poisoned safe routes.

Mo filled the air with moving paper.

Arin cut Wheel seams.

Luo struck every opening Sera created.

Sera tied the battlefield together.

For forty-two seconds, Huo fought all five.

The world saw what current Marquises actually were.

Monsters.

Yun forced purge.

Mo forced attention.

Arin forced reconstruction.

Luo forced alternate circulation.

Sera forced choices.

Huo still adapted.

Then all nine Wheels linked through one rotating pressure cycle.

The field compressed.

Every Marquis hit the ground.

Sera rose first.

Huo looked at her.

[[speaker:huo]]“This generation is better.”

Sera wiped blood from her lip.

[[speaker:sera]]“We know.”

title: Rhen Does Not Move
text:
Rhen remained on the ridge.

Sera understood why.

She had not asked.

And the Marquises were still alive, still choosing, still fighting.

Huo looked toward him once.

That was a mistake.

Sera's wire caught Wheel Five.

Arin cut the connection.

Mo buried it beneath reinforced pages.

Yun's toxin entered the break.

Luo struck the same point nine times.

Huo staggered.

Rhen smiled faintly.

Sera saw.

[[speaker:sera]]“Stop enjoying this!”

[[speaker:rhen]]“You look impressive.”

Sera almost missed her next step.

[[speaker:sera]]“NOT NOW.”

Even Huo looked confused.

The distraction bought Arin another seam.

title: The Empty Throne Trumps Them
text:
The end came when Huo stopped treating the Wheels as separate.

Nine Heavens became one rotation.

Yun's toxin met purge before adapting.

Mo's pages met stored force before changing.

Arin's seam vanished before the sword completed.

Luo's acupoints rerouted before shutdown.

Sera's false positions faced pressure wide enough to punish every possibility.

One by one, the Marquises fell.

Yun unconscious but breathing.

Mo with broken fingers.

Arin's sword snapped.

Luo barely standing.

Sera still upright.

Huo approached her last.

[[speaker:huo]]“Six.”

Sera raised one remaining wire.

[[speaker:sera]]“Still here.”

They exchanged three more times.

Huo won the fourth.

Rhen appeared beside Sera before she stopped sliding.

He caught her.

[[speaker:rhen]]“Done?”

Sera breathed hard.

[[speaker:sera]]“For today.”

title: What They Learned
text:
Recovery took three days.

The Marquises reconstructed the battle.

Arin's seam still disconnected Wheels.

Mo could force environmental rewrites.

Yun could force purge.

Luo could create circulation debt.

Sera could still reach the centre.

They had lost.

They had also learned.

Kael arrived during the fourth meeting.

He looked at all five.

[[speaker:kael]]“You fought him together.”

Sera nodded.

[[speaker:kael]]“And?”

Mo raised two splinted fingers.

[[speaker:mo]]“Expensive.”

Yun coughed.

[[speaker:yun]]“Rude.”

Arin placed the broken sword on the table.

Kael understood.

The rematch was no longer theoretical.

title: Another Number One
text:
Before Kael could fight Huo, another man entered the story.

Tae Muyeon.

The **Horizon King**.

Unranked.

His reputation placed him roughly beside Kael on the right battlefield, though the two had never completed a serious duel.

His martial system was **Boundless Horizon**.

Not teleportation.

Distance control through movement geometry.

A strike one metre short became perfect when Tae's step closed the missing measure. An opponent charging him found the final metre arriving at the wrong time.

Sera watched him cross the tea shop.

Three steps.

Yet he reached the counter earlier than expected.

Rhen watched too.

Tae looked at him, paused, then wisely looked back at Sera.

[[speaker:tae]]“I heard Huo Wujin is interesting.”

Sera sighed.

Another unranked monster.
